notes: AN ACTIVITY LOG. The last release fixed a fault that could leave the app running with no window and refusing to close. Finding the cause was far harder than it should have been, for a simple reason: THE APP KEPT NO RECORD OF WHAT IT HAD DONE. There was nothing to read afterwards — no file, no report — so the explanation had to be reconstructed rather than looked up. That is now fixed for next time. WHAT IT RECORDS. A plain text file, one line per event, in the app own folder: that the app started and which version, that a window opened and that the last one closed, that your books were opened, closed or reopened, that a quit was asked for and what the app did about it, and anything that crashed. Reach it from HELP, SOFTWARE AND SUPPORT, SHOW ACTIVITY LOG — which opens the folder holding the file. You can read it in any text editor and send it to support if you are ever asked for it. WHAT IT DOES NOT RECORD. No transaction, no name, no amount, no password. It records that a thing HAPPENED, never what was in it. Anything resembling a password, passphrase, key, token or secret is written as redacted, and no part of the app passes one to it in the first place — that rule is enforced by a test, not left to good intentions. The file is capped at half a megabyte; past that it rolls over once and starts again, so a machine left running for years cannot fill a disk with it. And it can never break the app: if the log cannot be written, because of a full disk or a permissions problem, it stays quiet and the app carries on exactly as before. That is tested by making the write fail on purpose. CARRIES EVERYTHING IN THE PREVIOUS RELEASE unchanged. NO DATA CHANGES — this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
